topic: 5 things to prepare before hiring a dev team
caption:
Hiring a dev team for your app or platform? Have these 5 things ready before the first call. They'll save you weeks and a lot of money. 💡

1️⃣ The problem, in one sentence
2️⃣ Who your users are
3️⃣ Must-haves vs. nice-to-haves
4️⃣ A realistic budget range
5️⃣ How you'll measure success

slides.title: 5 things to have ready before the first call.
slides.sub: They'll save you weeks, and a lot of money.

slides.title: The problem, in one sentence
slides.body: Not the features. The problem. “Clinics lose bookings in WhatsApp chats” beats a 40-item feature list.

slides.title: Who your users are
slides.body: Customers, staff, admins? Each user type adds screens, permissions and testing.

slides.title: Must-haves vs. nice-to-haves
slides.body: Your first version should do 3 to 5 things really well. Everything else goes on the roadmap.

slides.title: A realistic budget range
slides.body: Not an exact number, a range. It lets a good team suggest the right scope instead of guessing.

slides.title: How you'll measure success
slides.body: Sign-ups? Orders? Hours saved? Define it now so every decision points at it.
